Permissions and limits
The browser asks for access to the folder you select. We fetch only same-site pinned text files, verify their SHA-256 hashes before and after writing, and keep a small ownership record inside the skill folder. No commands run, no project files are uploaded, and no folder handle is saved.
Existing unmanaged folders are refused. Undo removes only recorded files that still match the reviewed package; modified or unrelated files stay. Empty directories remain. This installs files; Codex activation is a separate check.
